purpose: RNA-seq quantification completion for the same Tartary buckwheat study, 31 further public SRA runs across three library shapes: 22 single-end SRA archives (SRR11592354-61, SRR30067602-09, SRR30415358-63), 6 paired-end deep SRA archives (SRR15219542-47, 2.1-2.9 GB each), and 3 paired-end runs quantified directly from delivered fastq.gz without unpacking (SRR8759198-200). Every quant.sf carries the full 33,955-transcript ID set. Authoritative SRA files were consumed read-only and left in place.

methodology.backends_flag: rust-orchestrated upstream salmon 2.7.0 (bioconda), -l A, -p 8, --validateMappings, --seqBias --gcBias; single-end runs use salmon -r; gz inputs are streamed in place
methodology.repeat_flag: 1 per run, serial batch, completed runs skipped on resume
methodology.disclosure: no legacy output exists for these runs by construction; correctness rests on the parity established in bench-20260914-003/004 plus full ID-set checks; the workstation was otherwise idle during this batch

environment.cpu_model: Intel Xeon E5-2676 v3 @ 2.40GHz (24 threads; runs pinned to cores 8-15, nice 10)
environment.gpu: AMD Radeon RX 580 2048SP (Polaris 20, amdgpu kernel driver; unused by these workloads)
environment.memory: 32 GiB DDR3-1600 MT/s (2x16 GiB DIMM_B1/D1, 72-bit width)
environment.storage: system/log: Kingston SA400S37 120 GB SSD; benchmark I/O data volume: WDC WD5000AZLX 500 GB 7200rpm HDD; bulk reference data: Seagate ST3000DM001 3 TB HDD
environment.code_revision: v1.0.3 release binary (workstation deployment, built 2026-09-14) + post-release ops scripts

data_sources.reference: workstation salmon index, Pinku1 CDS (33,955 transcripts), read-only
data_sources.note: same index as every quantification in this study

data_sources.reference: NCBI SRA runs SRR11592354-61, SRR30067602-09, SRR30415358-63, SRR15219542-47, SRR8759198-200 (Tartary buckwheat); local authoritative copies, read-only
data_sources.note: SRR8759198-200 quantified in place from fastq.gz; files unmodified

entries.dataset: 31 runs: 20 single-end SRA (median quant 16 s), 6 paired deep SRA (median 172 s), 2 paired gz-direct (median 86 s)
entries.consistency: 31/31 quant.sf carry the full 33,955-transcript ID set; no-reference by construction
